verdict.rationale: Fivetran's pricing page lists "1-minute syncs", which shows the product supports sub-hour sync frequencies. Nothing documents how frequency is set per connection, cron expressions, or on-demand sync triggers. Connection-level re-sync is a historical re-sync rather than a scheduling control, and the scheduled transformations are not data syncs. missing for 10: documented per-connection sync-frequency configuration, cron-expression scheduling, manual/on-demand sync trigger (UI or API), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I control sync frequency per pipeline — from sub-hour schedules to cron expressions and manual triggers
